cases.description: Currently the `stm32h730` doesn't allow using `rcc::Pll::fracn`, despite having support.

evidence.eventual_fix_problem_statement:
fix: allow the `stm32h730` to use `fracn`

Re-targets `rcc::Pll::fracn` to support the `stm32h730`.

Might be better to make a separate config along the lines of "pll_fracn_support", or a feature (since it's based on the specific chip).

fixes #6021
